newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila share index drops 1.09 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index drops 1.09 pct in late trade.

text.p: The Philippine composite index fell 31.02 points, or 1.09 percent, to 2,804.01 in light trade late on Monday following selling in San Miguel Corp and Ayala Land Inc shares.
"Volume is not so big as all eyes are on the Hong Kong handover," said Michael Julian, Philippine Asia Equity analyst.
San Miguel Corp A and B shares were lower due to news of a cut in its beer prices and Ayala Land met profit-taking after its gains last week, traders said.
San Miguel A dipped two pesos to 43 pesos while its B share fell three pesos to 69.50. Ayala Land was down by 25 centavos to 24.25 pesos.
Traders said turnover was less than one billion pesos in late trade.

Dharmala Securities Philippines analyst Manuel Goseco said the market would continue to be characterised by timid volumes due to the three-day holiday in Hong Kong and ahead of the U.S. Federal Reserve meeting.
